messages:
Sana Iqbal: Quick proposal: tighten PM follow-ups by adding a compact, machine-readable remediation block plus a small 'validator' role separate from the fixer. Also tweaking IC rotation to 3-day shifts with a mandatory shadow handoff. Thoughts?

Ethan Brooks: I like the validator idea. too often the dev marks a task done without a proper smoke verification. a separate verification owner would help.

Maya Ortiz: Agree. For cadence suggest 48h / 7d / 28d checkpoints. 48h catches early drift, 7d for short triage, 28d for no-regression smoke. Ops-bot can ping at each checkpoint.

Liam Chen: For the remediation block, keep it tiny and strict so our parser can pick it up from Jira comments. Fields: remediation, fixer, validator, due, smoke_id, failure_mode, prevented_by, checkpoints, pm_link.

Sana Iqbal: Draft block (paste into PM or ticket):

```
remediation: "short summary"
fixer: "Name (team)"
validator: "Name (verification)"
due: "YYYY-MM-DD"
smoke_id: "smoke-suite-id or url"
failure_mode: [auth, cache, db, infra]
prevented_by: "guardrail description"
checkpoints: "48h:status,7d:status,28d:status"
pm_link: "postmortem url"
notes: "optional"
```

Ethan Brooks: Governance idea: if 48h has no progress -> ops-bot pings fixer and validator; if 7d untouched -> escalate to tech lead and create a follow-up card; if validator hasn't signoff by 28d -> auto-create a regression ticket and notify product.

Maya Ortiz: Also require a verification artifact link (smoke_id) before closing. validator should attach the smoke run or a short test log. Dashboard can show %with_verification.

Liam Chen: IC rotation: 3-day shifts with a half-day shadow on day 3. outgoing+incoming pair for 1 hour to walk remediations and outstanding checkpoints. IC picks comms cadence on declare: fast (initial/15m/30m/1h/final) or normal (initial/30m/hour/final). Ops-bot pins the cadence.

Sana Iqbal: Recurrence tracking: require failure_mode tags. weekly job aggregates tags and posts a top-5 heatmap to #eng-leads. That will highlight systemic failure modes.

Ethan Brooks: Implementation note: parser should accept the block as plain key:value lines. I'll prototype an extractor that emits CSV rows to BigQuery and a weekly heatmap job. ETA: 12 days for first prototype.

Maya Ortiz: Escalation ladder note: missing 48h -> owner ping; missing 7d -> tech lead; missing 14d -> manager; missing 28d verification -> product triage and backlog bug. Keep it visible in the ticket so no surprises.

ops-bot: Incident REM-2024-999 moved to remediation. Fixer assigned: Sana Iqbal. Validator assigned: Liam Chen. Checkpoint reminders scheduled at 48h, 7d, 28d. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REM-2024-999 

Sana Iqbal: Thanks ops-bot. I'll fill in the block in the ticket now and attach the smoke run once complete. Can we have the 48h ping go to the fixer+validator DMs and post a summary in #eng-oncall?

Ethan Brooks: Yes 90 webhook can DM both and post summary. Also include the escalation triggers we discussed.

Liam Chen: For the validator role, we should add a small checklist: run smoke, confirm metrics, attach log. If automated, attach smoke_id; if manual, attach short verification note.

Maya Ortiz: OK action items: (1) Ethan -> prototype extractor + heatmap job (owner: Ethan, due: 12 days). (2) Liam -> validator checklist + short doc for signoff steps (owner: Liam, due: 4 days). (3) Sana -> add remediation block to REM-2024-999 and enable checkpoint scheduling (owner: Sana, due: today). (4) Maya -> RFC for 3-day IC rotation + shadow handoff (owner: Maya, due: 5 days). Please confirm.

Ethan Brooks: Confirmed, starting extractor tomorrow.

Liam Chen: Confirmed, drafting checklist.

Sana Iqbal: Confirmed, updating ticket now.

Maya Ortiz: Confirmed. I'll schedule a quick sync after drafts are ready.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 48h checkpoint for REM-2024-999 will post to #eng-oncall at 3209962943.
